content.title: Married filing jointly updates the standard deduction to $29,200
content.intent: Prove choosing Married filing jointly changes the Deductions row to the married standard deduction amount.
content.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning with a representative positive annual income of 85000 so the estimate panel is populated while isolating the filing-status effect. Risk-judged interaction strength was 3 because money applies, but no covering array was used because each filing status produces a distinct required deduction amount and therefore became its own scenario.
